title: Food picture cards
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from science/y3 lesson 6 (Food picture cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: Food for our bodies: a balanced diet. To understand why animals, including humans, need to eat a balanced diet

cards:
nutrition
getting the food our body
needs

carbohydrate
food that gives us energy,
like bread and rice

protein
food for growing and mending,
like fish, eggs and beans

diet
the food we usually eat

balanced
the right amount of each kind
of food
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Sort: chicken, bread, carrot. Which group is each?
questions.a: Chicken: protein; bread: carbohydrate; carrot: fruit and vegetables
questions.model: Take one at a time. Chicken helps us grow: protein. Bread gives energy: carbohydrate. Carrot is a vegetable: vitamins.

questions.q: Name a protein that comes from a plant.
Plan one day of meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) on the plate sheet. Colour each food by its group.
questions.a: For example: porridge and banana; chicken and rice with salad; lentil soup, bread and yoghurt
questions.model: Teacher plans breakfast first: porridge (carbohydrate, dairy) and a banana (fruit). Two groups already.

questions.q: Check your plan. Which group is missing or too big?
questions.a: Pupils' own; for example 'I need more vegetables.'

questions.q: A lion eats only meat. How does it get the energy a plant once stored?
questions.a: It eats animals that ate plants, so the energy came from plants first.

questions.q: Big question: why can't you make your own food like a plant?
questions.a: Animals cannot make food from sunlight; we must eat it.
